purpose: Track Markdown producer bundles and enforce one optional humanize-korean handoff owned by the outermost producer.

producer_skills.structural_validator: project layout allowlist, AGENTS canonical context, CLAUDE @AGENTS.md bridge
producer_skills.handoff: Outermost owner offers one humanize-korean document-refinement proposal after structural validation.

producer_skills.structural_validator: design output, context references, AGENTS/CLAUDE bridge and output paths
producer_skills.handoff: Own the combined design-doc/context-doc bundle; suppress both child handoffs and offer once after final validation.

producer_skills.structural_validator: instruction references, AGENTS canonical context and CLAUDE @AGENTS.md bridge
producer_skills.handoff: Offer once only when directly invoked; return draft and validation result when a parent owns the bundle.

producer_skills.structural_validator: required sections, requirement traceability, links and save path
producer_skills.handoff: Offer once only when directly invoked and after OUTPUT validation.

producer_skills.structural_validator: seven quality checks, requirement coverage, routes, tables and code fences
producer_skills.handoff: Offer once only when directly invoked; revalidate before create-prototype handoff.

producer_skills.structural_validator: task IDs, commands, paths, verification scenarios and roadmap index links
producer_skills.handoff: Offer once for the plan/index bundle and revalidate before downstream implementation.

producer_skills.structural_validator: FE-API-BE-DB traceability, task IDs, paths, verification scenarios and roadmap index links
producer_skills.handoff: Offer once for the FE/BE plan/index bundle and revalidate before downstream implementation.

producer_skills.condition: Only when the user explicitly asks to persist the design system. The default is a chat report with no file write.
producer_skills.structural_validator: required sections, token tables, slug-safe paths, MASTER/override split
producer_skills.handoff: Offer once only when directly invoked and the outermost producer; suppress when a parent owns the bundle.

producer_skills.condition: Only when the user explicitly asks to persist the motion spec. The default is a chat report with no file write.
producer_skills.structural_validator: required spec fields, slug-safe paths, reduced-motion alternative present
producer_skills.handoff: Offer once only when directly invoked and the outermost producer; suppress when a parent owns the bundle.

bundle_contract.artifact_bundle_id: required and stable across nested producer calls
bundle_contract.handoff_completed: in-session state set after propose, skip, reject, apply, or revalidate
bundle_contract.artifact_bundle_fingerprint: SHA-256 over the sorted normalized Markdown paths, each content SHA-256, and the profile name
bundle_contract.persistent_ledger: .docs/.harness/humanize-handoffs.json; atomically keyed by artifact_bundle_fingerprint so retries and new sessions do not offer unchanged content twice

required_order: one proposal-only humanize-korean handoff by the owner
explicit user approval before any write
producer structural revalidation after approved apply
downstream consumes only the revalidated final Markdown

protected_tokens.purpose: Values that carry mechanical meaning must survive document refinement unchanged. Refinement improves prose, never data.
design_system_documents: hex, RGB and HSL colour values
CSS variable and design token names
motion_documents: easing curve names and cubic-bezier coefficients
